paite: Himahleh kei sanga naupang, a pate uh ka ganching uite toh koih dia ka sitten, kei nuihzabawlna in a hon zang uh.
english: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to put with my sheep dogs.

paite: A hi, a khutte uh hata, huaiin kei bang a honlohtak dia, huai a hatna uh beisaten?
english: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?

paite: Taksapna leh kialna in a tuikang ua; lei keu leh sia a kheuh uh,
english: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.

paite: Pawna annteh a lou ua; huan loukha zungte a an uh ahi.
english: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom are their food.

paite: Mite lak akipan hawl khiakin a om ua; guta nung bangin amau nungah a kikou ua.
english: They are driven out from the midst of men. They cry after them as after a thief;

paite: Guama hengte ah a teng ngei ding ua, lei leh suangpi hawmte ah.
english: So that they dwell in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.

paite: Pawn lakah a ham ua; lahou nuaite ah a kise-khawm uh.
english: Among the bushes they bray; and under the nettles they are gathered together.

paite: Mihaite tate ahi ua, ahi, mi thulimloute tate; gama kipanin delhkhiak ahi uh
english: They are children of fools, yes, children of base men. They were flogged out of the land.

paite: Huan tuin kei a la uh ka honghia ahi, amaua dingin houlimna ka hi.
english: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.

paite: A honkih ua, kei akipan a tuam din uh, ka maia chil siat a kidek kei uh.
english: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.

paite: Pathianin lah Ka khau a khaha, a honhihgim hi, huan ka maah kamkaihna a khahkhia uh.
english: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.

paite: Ka khut taklam pangah mipi thuzohlouhte a thou ua; ka khe a a nawlkhin ua, huchiin a siatna lampi uh ka maah a koih uh.
english: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet, They cast up against me their ways of destruction.

paite: Ka lampi a hihsia ua, ka tuahsiatna a zong ua, kuaman a kham kei uh.
english: They mar my path, They set forward my calamity, without anyone’s help.

paite: Awng zapia paisuak bangin a hong ua: siatna lakah ka tungah a kikhuk uh.
english: As through a wide breach they come, in the midst of the ruin they roll themselves in.

paite: Launate ka tungah a hei ua, huih bangin ka minphatna a delhmang uh; huan meipi bangin ka hauhna a paimang hi.
english: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.

paite: Huchiin tuin ka sungah ka kha buakkhiakin a om; gimthuakna niten kei a honman uh.
english: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold on me.

paite: Janin ka guhte a sawi, huan kei honseuh natna ten khawl chih a neikei uh.
english: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.

paite: Ka natna hi hat mahmahna jiakin ka puansilh a nina: ka puannak ngawng bangin kei a honggak hi.
english: By great force is my garment disfigured. It binds me about as the collar of my coat.

paite: Buannawi ah a honpai luta, huan leivui leh meivu bang ka honghi hi.
english: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.

paite: Na kiangah ka kikoua, huan non dawng kei hi: Ka dinga, huan kei non en maimaha.
english: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.

paite: Ka tunga khel dingin na kilumleta: na ban hatnain kei non sawi hi.
english: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.

paite: Huihah non domkang tou a, huai tungah na hontuang sak; huan huih ah non lumlet let hi.
english: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.

paite: Sihna na hontun ding chih lah ka thei ngala, huan mihing tengteng adia sehsa in ah.
english: For I know that you will bring me to death, To the house appointed for all living.

paite: Hitamahleh siatnaa pukgawp miin a ban jak lou ding hia? Ahihkeileh a tuahsiatna ah panpihna ngenin kikou lou ding hia?
english: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?

paite: Buainaa om adingin ka kap kei maw? Tasamte adingin ka kha a dah kei maw?
english: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?

paite: Hoih ka ngak chiangin, hoihlou a hongpaia; khovak ka ngak chiangin, khomial a hongpai.
english: When I looked for good, then evil came; When I waited for light, there came darkness.

paite: Ka lungtang a buai, khawl a mu ngei kei; gimthuakna nite ka tungah a hongtung.
english: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.

paite: Hihvoma omin ka vialvak, himahleh ni hihvom hilou-in; khawmpi ah ka dinga panpih deihin ka kikou hi.
english: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

paite: Sehalte unaupa ka hia, vakengsangte lawm ka hi hi.
english: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.

paite: Ka vun a voma, kei akipan a pilh uh, huan kholumin ka guhte a kang hi.Huaijiakin ka kaihging sunna a suaka, ka mutging mikapte aw.
english: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.

paite: Huaijiakin ka kaihging sunna a suaka, ka mutging mikapte aw.
english: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.
